observation: On one 5s animated garment-text source, Wan 2.7 erased CHEER while preserving required forehead ratings; Seedance Mini erased CHEER and both protected ratings, and Flash rebuilt a different landscape scene with CHEER remaining. Actual credits 80/50/20. Keep Wan 2.7 default; Mini remains explicitly scoped test-only. Do not generalize to every source or treat clean text removal as subject fidelity.
limitations: One animated source and one initial task per model; not evidence for universal model ranking.
Same agent prepared and reviewed, and native aspect/fps can reveal model identity. Operational anonymization is not an independent blind study.
Review uses complete garment-frame contact sequences and 13 native full-frame samples, not a claim of continuous real-time audiovisual playback or full-frame every-pixel inspection.
Only erasure/visual fidelity compared; translated text, dubbing and full-video localization acceptance are outside scope.
